# UI and Documentation

## Source scope

Based on User Interface, pp. 143-147, and Documentation, pp. 148-156.

## User interface

- Prefer Fiori Elements when it meets the requirement; use Fiori Freestyle or the Flexible Programming Model only when their additional control is needed.
- Keep UI behavior aligned with service, RAP, CDS, authorization, and Clean Core boundaries. Treat legacy UI technologies as compatibility choices, not defaults for new development.

## Documentation

- Maintain meaningful short descriptions for development objects and document changes where future maintainers need the rationale.
- Use ABAP Doc for public APIs and keep source comments concise; follow the project's documentation language and version-control documentation conventions.
- Keep cross-object and knowledge-transfer documentation where object-level comments cannot explain architecture, operations, or dependencies.
